title: International Foundation Diploma In Employability Skills Level 3
description: Enhance your career potential and leadership abilities with the International Foundation Diploma in Employability Skills (Level 3).
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and OTHM UK
longDescription: The Employability Skills course focuses on developing essential skills such as Career Planning and Development, Managing own Performance, Personal and Professional Development,Employment Skills,Working in a Business Environment and Managing Resources. It prepares students to excel in the workplace and enhance their career prospects. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 240 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: The International FoundationDiploma in Employability Skills (Level 3) course equips students with Career Planning and Development, Managing own Performance, Personal and Professional development, Skills,Working in a Business Environment and Managing Resources. It covers time management, problem-solving, and teamwork, emphasizing real-world applications. Students also learn to enhance their CVs, improve interview techniques, and develop professional behavior. The course is designed to boost confidence and prepare graduates for diverse career opportunities.

entry: Endorsed Diploma In Employability Skills (Level-3), learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: Upon completing the endorsed Diploma In Employability skills (Level-3) students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a master's degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as business administration, finance, or marketing.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
certificateDetails: You will receive a degree from GSS Partner Universities.
Complete several modules ranging from Business Leadership and Managing People.
Obtain a degree without necessarily leaving your country.

modules.title: Career Planning And Development
modules.summary: This module introduces students to the essential skills and strategies needed for effective career planning and development. Students will explore personal career goals, employability skills, workplace expectations, and strategies for long-term professional growth. By the end of the module, students will develop a comprehensive career plan, enhancing their readiness for employment or further education.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Understanding Career Planning and Goal Setting
Unit 2 Building Employability Skills
Unit 3 Exploring Workplace Expectations and Professionalism
Unit 4 Creating a Personal Career Development Plan
Unit 5 Strategies for Continuous Professional Growth
Unit 1 Understanding Personal Accountability and Responsibility
Unit 2 Setting Goals and Managing Time Effectively
Unit 3 Evaluating and Improving Personal Performance
Unit 4 Overcoming Challenges and Maintaining Resilience
Unit 5 Strategies for Continuous Self-Improvement

modules.title: Personal And Professional Development
modules.summary: This module focuses on equipping students with the skills and knowledge necessary to manage their personal and professional growth effectively. It encourages self-reflection, goal setting, and the development of strategies to improve both personal and professional aspects of life. By exploring key concepts such as self-awareness, career planning, and skill enhancement, students will be empowered to take control of their future and achieve long-term success.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Self-Awareness and Personal Reflection
Unit 2 Setting Personal and Professional Goals
Unit 3 Developing Key Skills for Career Success
Unit 4 Time Management and Productivity Techniques
Unit 5 Networking and Building Professional Relationships

modules.title: Employment Skills
modules.summary: The Employment Skills module is designed to equip students with the essential skills and knowledge required to succeed in today’s competitive job market. This module focuses on the development of key workplace competencies, including communication, teamwork, problem-solving, and professional development. Students will gain a thorough understanding of how to apply these skills in various workplace settings and will be prepared to meet the demands of future employers.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Understanding Workplace Expectations and Culture
Unit 2 Effective Communication in the Workplace
Unit 3 Teamwork and Collaboration Skills
Unit 4 Problem-Solving and Decision-Making in the Workplace
Unit 5 Time Management and Personal Organization
Unit 1 Introduction to Business Environment
Unit 2-3 Economic and Legal Environment
Unit 4 -5 Political and Socio Cultural Environment
Unit 6-7 Tecnological Environment and Environmental Factors

modules.title: Managing Resources
modules.summary: The "Managing Resources" module at Level 3 is designed to equip students with the knowledge and skills required to manage various resources effectively within an organization. The module covers key concepts such as resource allocation, financial management, human resource management, and strategic planning. Students will develop the ability to evaluate resource utilization, optimize efficiency, and contribute to organizational success through effective resource management practices.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Introduction to Resource Management
Unit 2 Financial Resource Management and Budgeting
Unit 3 Human Resource Management and Team Development
Unit 4 Managing Physical Resources and Infrastructure
Unit 5 Strategic Planning for Resource Allocation and Optimization
